name: Medical Miracle
description: If the Field Medic reaches a character at -10 hit points or lower within 3 minutes of death, a DC 40 Treat Injury check (no take 10/20) lets the dead character attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save to be restored to 1d6 hit points.
